intro: These Terms of Use apply to the Muda Vai Vem app (formerly Bulbo and "Broto: Plantas em Movimento"), developed and maintained by Jhonatan Borges. They explain what you can do on Muda Vai Vem, what isn't allowed and how community moderation works. By using the app, you agree to these terms and to our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Who can use Muda Vai Vem
sections.body:
• Muda Vai Vem is for people 18 and older.
• Each person should have a single account with truthful information.
• You're responsible for everything that happens on your account. Don't share your login.

sections.title: What you post
sections.body: Photos, posts, comments, listings, events and messages you send remain yours. By posting, you allow us to show that content to other users inside Muda Vai Vem for as long as it stays published. Only post content you have the right to share.

sections.title: What isn't allowed
sections.body:
• Spam, repeated advertising or off-topic content posted in bulk.
• Scams: asking for payment upfront with no intention to deliver, fake listings, misleading links.
• Selling or trading endangered or legally protected species, banned plants or any illegal product.
• Insults, threats, harassment, hate speech or discrimination.
• Nudity, sexual or violent content.
• Sharing other people's personal data without permission.
• Impersonating another person or business.
• Trying to get around moderation, such as creating another account after being suspended.

sections.title: Trades, giveaways and sales
sections.body: Trades, giveaways and sales are arranged directly between users. Muda Vai Vem doesn't handle payments, deliveries or the condition of plants and isn't responsible for agreements between people. Prefer meeting in public places, check the plant before paying and be wary of requests for payment upfront.

sections.title: AI identification and diagnosis
sections.body: Identifications, diagnoses and care tips are generated by artificial intelligence and may contain mistakes. Use them as guidance, not as a guarantee. Before eating any plant or leaving it within reach of children and pets, confirm with a reliable source that it isn't toxic.

sections.title: Reports, blocking and moderation
Plans and credits
sections.body: Subscriptions and credit packs are charged by Google Play or the App Store, under each store's rules. Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled in the store. Deleting your account doesn't cancel your subscription. Credits are non-refundable, except where the law requires otherwise.

sections.title: Closing your account
sections.body: You can delete your account at any time in Profile > Settings > Delete account. We may suspend or close accounts that violate these terms.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms to reflect changes to the app or the law. When there are significant changes, we'll let you know inside the app and may ask you to accept the new version.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil.
